item.title: Back to OS X
item.description: I tried switching back from (Mac) OS X to Linux, but unfortunately, I am now returning back. I have been using Linux for the most part of the past thirteen years. The last seven, I have been switching back and forth between Apple’s OS X and various Linux distributions. The machines I use are an ancient Macbook Pro 15″ (2006) and my fairly recent Macbook Air 13″ (mid-2011). Now, for the first time, I am considering staying with OS X for good, despite really not wanting to.
